hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 0; [ "$CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE" = "true" ] || exit 0; if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then cmd='npm ci'; else cmd='npm install'; fi; if $cmd --no-audit --no-fund >/tmp/session-npm.log 2>&1; then echo "$cmd: ok"; else echo "$cmd: failed, see /tmp/session-npm.log"; fi; if [ -f scripts/ensure-chromium.sh ] && [ -d node_modules/playwright-core ]; then bash scripts/ensure-chromium.sh >/tmp/session-chromium.log 2>&1 && echo 'chromium: ok' || echo 'chromium: failed, see /tmp/session-chromium.log'; fi; exit 0

[ "$CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE" = "true" ] || exit 0; if [ -f /opt/claude-cloud/rules.md ]; then cat /opt/claude-cloud/rules.md; else echo 'Правила общения с продюсером не найдены в облачном окружении (/opt/claude-cloud/rules.md): действуй по CLAUDE.md, раздел «Как писать продюсеру».'; fi; exit 0
